Self.Wiki: Ride jump (formerly Mount Jump; handled by the game's CSRideJumpRegionManImpl). A spiritspring: riding Torrent into it launches the player upwards. An SFX marks it. A Ride Jump-off usually covers the descent below. For a spiritspring that can be sealed by an event flag, see DLC Ride Jump.

JumpHeight.Wiki: Height the player will move upwards when activating this spiritspring.

SfxID.Wiki: SFX shown at the spiritspring. A negative value uses GameSystemCommonParam rideJumpRegionDefaultSfxId (806730 in retail). Retail uses -1 (48 regions), 806731 (11) and 806730 (2).
